description: Figure 4 is a bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," which compares the runtime performance of the authors' "Our Joint Framework" against several large language models (LLMs) on the SEconvo dataset. The vertical axis represents "Runtime (seconds)" with a scale from 0 to 400, marked at intervals of 50. The horizontal axis lists the models being compared: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The chart uses two colors to differentiate the models: a dark green bar for "Our Joint Framework" and light blue bars for the LLMs. The runtime for "Our Joint Framework" is 77 seconds. The runtimes for the LLMs are significantly higher: 190 seconds for ChatGPT, 365 seconds for DeepSeek, 172 seconds for LLaMA, and 243 seconds for Claude. The chart clearly illustrates that the proposed joint framework has a substantially lower runtime compared to all the LLM models tested.
